hero.headline: Your home, professionally managed.
hero.subheadline: Homeworke connects homeowners with vetted service providers, guided by dedicated project managers — while keeping your real estate pro, lender, and insurance agent in the loop. Request an estimate in under two minutes.

marketplace.label: What does your home need?
marketplace.placeholder: Describe what is going on — e.g., "my water heater is leaking" or "I need the kitchen remodeled"
marketplace.helper: Our AI will match you to the right service category and connect you with up to three vetted providers.
marketplace.trustLine: Every provider is licensed, insured, and background-checked before they are approved to work on your home.

audienceTiles.title: Homeowners
audienceTiles.text: Book estimates, track projects in real time, and pay only as milestones are completed. Your home profile even includes property valuation and financing tools.

audienceTiles.title: Real Estate Professionals
audienceTiles.text: Stay top-of-mind with past clients through automatic project notifications. Earn referral income, access Express Estimates for negotiations, and manage your client roster from a single dashboard.

audienceTiles.title: Offices and Brokerages
audienceTiles.text: View agent production, track attributed revenue, and oversee your team's client engagement — all from an office-level dashboard with full reporting.

audienceTiles.title: Lenders
audienceTiles.text: Surface refinancing and home-improvement loan opportunities the moment your clients begin a project. Integrated financing widgets keep you in the conversation.

audienceTiles.title: Home Inspectors
audienceTiles.text: Share inspection reports directly into the Homeworke workflow. Collaborate with agents, attorneys, and transaction coordinators through built-in sharing controls.

audienceTiles.title: Insurance Agents
audienceTiles.text: Receive notifications when clients complete improvements so you can update coverage and quotes proactively — strengthening your relationship without extra effort.

audienceTiles.title: Service Providers
audienceTiles.text: Accept jobs on your terms with clear scope, transparent pay, and milestone-based draws. Sign up in minutes, complete verification when you are ready to work.
